scope: All 12 frozen peninsula 1813 cohort entries; Pyrenees July25–August2, SanSebastian July9–September8, Pampeluna June26–October31 and Nive December9–13 intervals kept whole.
policy: Main session only. Maximum three preassigned families including Bodart, at most one targeted follow-up per entry. Only bibliographic catalogue information inspected before this record. Volumes, embedded reports and translations remain one family. No separate review, subagents, second opinions, scoring or feature admission.

families.oman-peninsular-war: British national retrospective history, VI(1922) and VII(1930), original reports mediated. IA catalogue names author1860–1946, meeting more than70years deceased rule; printed dates/title and source dependence to inspect.
families.suchet-memoires-espagne: French commander memoir, II(1834), existing pinned OCR; interested account, underlying local returns uninspected.
families.lapene-campagnes-1813-1814: French officer retrospective,1823, title/source dependence to verify; copies one family. May leave own-side local returns missing.

entries.reason: Eastern theatre own-side Suchet plus British account, or western theatre own-side Lapène plus British account. No fourth family if local figures remain missing.
